title: Why Do Some Dogs Absolutely Love Water?
description:
Not every dog is built to hate the bath — some are basically part fish.

script: If bath time is a nightmare but the second a lake shows up your dog does a full sprint dive, that's not a contradiction, it's breed history. Some dogs were literally built for water, retrievers, water spaniels, and similar breeds were bred over generations to pull nets, retrieve waterfowl, and swim for hours, they often have webbed paws and water-resistant double coats designed exactly for this. For those dogs, water isn't scary or unfamiliar, it's a job description written into their genetics. There's also a pure joy factor, buoyancy takes the strain off joints, the temperature feels great on a hot day, and swimming lets high-energy dogs burn a ton of energy fast without impact on their body. Combine that with positive associations, fetch, play, splashing with you, and you get a dog who treats any body of water like the best part of the day. Want more real dog behavior insight? The link's below.
